label: Diagram 6
caption: Diagram 6 Map showing wind speeds in m/s for maximum height of buildings
description: Titled "Diagram 6 Map showing wind speeds in m/s for maximum height of buildings", the image is a line chart with an inset. The vertical axis is labelled "Orography Factor O", scaled 1.00 to 1.40 in 0.05 steps; the horizontal axis is labelled "X/Lu" left of zero (ticks -1, -0.5) and "X/Ld" right of zero (ticks 0.5, 1, 1.5). Three bell-shaped curves rise from near 1.00 at the edges to central peaks: the top peaks at 1.35, labelled "Steep slope < 1/3.3"; the middle at 1.20, "Moderate slope = 1/5"; the lowest at 1.10, "Shallow slope ≤ 1/10". A shaded inset at top right depicts a building on a ridge, with vertical arrows "0.5z" and "z", a top dimension "0.5Ld", horizontal arrows "-X" and "+X" over base labels "Lu" and "Ld", and the note "Orography significant in shaded area" pointing to the shaded region above the roofline.
